name: PocketCurator
summary: Manages a user's own ROM collection from an EmulationStation-style interface.

notes: User-approved for review, but blocked: GitHub reports stable release v1.1.2 as mutable and the exact extracted size and complete archive inventory remain unresolved.
Runtime writes can span user-selected ROM, media, and gamelist paths. A narrow package policy and containment review are required before installation.
The built-in updater and netsync path can download executable code outside App Store checks and must be disabled in a reviewed package.
Upstream names TrimUI Smart Pro as tested without firmware or package-version detail. This is not enough for a Knulli device matrix; MagicX is not named.

evidence.note: Stable ZIP is 5903925 bytes with published SHA-256 bb1907289bb5e22c6d24c39b9fae6dac0c17b75821a6565d77fcba3cce9af664. GitHub reports the release as mutable; exact extracted inventory remains under review.
MIT project license and bundled dependency notices reviewed.
Upstream lists TrimUI Smart Pro, but does not tie that claim to Knulli, v1.1.2, or a lifecycle result.
